roleContext.jobDescription: An online learning platform recommends courses to 3 million learners and to the corporate customers who license its catalogue. The Applied Scientist builds and evaluates the recommendation models, designs online experiments with the growth team, mentors junior scientists and keeps the feature pipeline healthy. Each applicant's materials are summarised for a qualified interview panel, which makes every hiring decision. The recommendations team has six scientists and two machine-learning engineers and reports to the director of data science. Models are trained nightly, served through an internal ranking service and tested online before full release. Graduate scientists join the team each autumn and are each paired with a mentor for their first year.

requirements.text: Builds candidate-generation and ranking models for course recommendations.
Designs online experiments and analyses their results with the growth team.
Mentors junior scientists through regular one-to-ones and reviews of their work.
Maintains the feature pipeline that feeds the recommendation models.
Communicates results to product managers in written experiment reports.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Applied Scientist, Course Recommendations

## Experience

- Built a two-tower candidate-generation model and a gradient-boosted re-ranker for the course catalogue at Lumora Learning, trained nightly on enrolment and completion events.
- Designed and analysed 11 online experiments with the growth team between 2022 and 2024, pre-registering the primary metric (course starts per visitor) in each test plan.
- Added data-quality checks to the Airflow feature pipeline owned by the data engineering team, so that the nightly training run stops when an input table arrives late or empty.
- Wrote an experiment report for each test for the product managers, giving the effect estimate, its confidence interval and the decision the product owner took.
- Reviewed notebooks and pull requests from junior members of the recommendations team.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the experiment report for the 'continue learning' carousel test, with the pre-registered metric, an effect of +2.1% course starts per visitor (95% interval +0.8% to +3.4%) over a 14-day window, and the product owner's ship decision.
